programme_roles.EGWE: future-state sufficiency and residual origin/history after current state
programme_roles.TTF: out-of-species transferability of within-species transition/turnover structure

transition_field.question: does within-species transition turnover learned from training species predict transition turnover in unseen species?

typed_connectivity_increment.question: does a Structural/EGWE typed-connectivity predictor space add out-of-species transfer skill beyond the declared current-state/reference space?
typed_connectivity_increment.feature_rule: C must be frozen externally, training-only, or cross-fitted without evaluation-species outcomes

anti_leakage: never select TTF species because within-species C-minus-R was favorable
species eligibility may depend on response-independent support/admissibility and prospectively frozen estimability gates only
never tune connectivity radius, operator weights, transforms, reference variables, or endpoint semantics on evaluation-species outcomes
burned pilot partitions never enter TTF predictive transfer
TTF training/evaluation species split must be frozen before evaluation outcomes are used to fit any transfer field
evaluation species may not fit shared field parameters except under endpoint-safe cross-fitting explicitly permitted by the TTF protocol

interpretation_matrix.interpretation: candidate reusable cross-species state-transition rule in the tested domain
system_or_lineage_conditioned structure; not absence of within-system structure
abstain; support/estimability failure is not biological absence
TTF transfer may be descriptive/predictive for its own frozen predictor space but cannot rescue a failed Structural adequacy claim

current_empirical_boundaries.TTF_genetic_result: qualified cross-species post-IBD transfer not detected; within-species self test significant relative to frozen null
current_empirical_boundaries.note: TTF genetic result is an empirical example of self-detectability != transferability, not a replication of Structural connectivity

prohibited_claims: TTF genetic non-transfer proves Structural connectivity is lineage-specific
Structural A-Islands or Tanzania are TTF replications
within-species adequacy automatically implies cross-species transferability
operator portability and species transferability are the same property
pilot feasibility counts as transfer evidence
